description: For calculation groups. T has three rows: Qty A 10, B 20, C 30. Measures: [Total] = SUM ( T[Qty] ) = 60 (format string "#,0"), [Count] = COUNTROWS ( T ) = 3, [Ten] = 10. Calculation groups: Adjust[Adjustment] (precedence 100) with Current = SELECTEDMEASURE (), Plus 2 = SELECTEDMEASURE () + 2 and Only Total x10 (multiplies by 10 when the measure is [Total], otherwise leaves it); Scale[Scaling] (precedence 200) with Times 2 = SELECTEDMEASURE () * 2, Plus Count = SELECTEDMEASURE () + [Count] and Plus Rows = SELECTEDMEASURE () + COUNTROWS ( T ); Info[Info] (precedence 50) with Name = SELECTEDMEASURENAME (), Format = SELECTEDMEASUREFORMATSTRING (), Selected = SELECTEDVALUE ( Info[Info] ) and Is Total or Count = ISSELECTEDMEASURE ( [Total], [Count] ); Variant[Variant] (precedence 10) with Base = SELECTEDMEASURE (), Double = SELECTEDMEASURE () * 2, Diff = SELECTEDMEASURE () - CALCULATE ( SELECTEDMEASURE (), Variant[Variant] = "Double" ) and Ratio = DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( SELECTEDMEASURE (), Variant[Variant] = "Diff" ), CALCULATE ( SELECTEDMEASURE (), Variant[Variant] = "Double" ) ).

items.name: Ratio
items.expression: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( SELECTEDMEASURE (), Variant[Variant] = "Diff" ), CALCULATE ( SELECTEDMEASURE (), Variant[Variant] = "Double" ) )
